note: The setup's first extractor and actions (899 s).
instructions:
Play the game well. Tetris. Pieces fall into a 10-column well. Left and Right arrows move the falling piece, X rotates it clockwise and Z counter-clockwise, holding Down drops it faster. A completely filled row clears. The game ends when the pieces stack up to the top. Clear as many rows as you can.
Each decision, the state already has the best landing spot that the falling piece can still reach. It was chosen by scoring every spot on landing height, rows cleared, holes, wells and transitions, with a look at the next piece. turnsCW and turnsCCW are the X and Z presses still needed to reach that spot's orientation. shift is the number of columns still to move (negative = left). aligned is true when turnsCW and shift are both 0. turned and movedX report what changed since the last decision. A key that just worked must be let go with none for one decision before it can work again. Rules, in order: playing false -> start. piece null -> none. aligned -> drop (keep holding Down until the piece lands). turnsCW > 0 and turnFits -> none if turned; otherwise rotate_ccw if turnsCCW < turnsCW, else rotate_cw. Otherwise move toward shift. If shift is 0 because the turn does not fit, go right if pieceCol < 4, else left. If freeLeft or freeRight on that side is 0, go the other way only while a turn is still needed; otherwise drop. Going left: none if movedX < 0, else left. Going right: none if movedX > 0, else right. planLines, planHoles and planHeight describe the chosen landing. hereLines and hereHoles show what dropping straight down now would give. rowsToLand is how far the piece can still fall. height and holes describe the current stack.

actions.description: release all keys; the piece keeps falling at normal speed
hold Left arrow: shift the piece one column left
hold Right arrow: shift the piece one column right
hold X: rotate the piece clockwise once
hold Z: rotate the piece counter-clockwise once
hold Down: the piece falls fast until it lands
click the game centre to start or restart when no game is on
